plan.title: SRC-NEG-019 Counter Offer on Surrogate Bid

steps.note: the API built this case's state
Ensure counter offers are not hidden on RFQ stages.
Enable eRFX project creation required for the RFQ setup.
Configure the event as an RFQ-only project.
Work on the RFQ stage before configuring its template and items.
Add the line item needed for the surrogate bid.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite the vendor whose surrogate bid will be tested.
Open the RFQ Participants list where surrogate bids are entered.
Enter a buyer-side bid on behalf of Vendor C.
Confirm the surrogate bid was accepted.
Open the RFQ Responses tab containing Vendor C's bid.
Verify the response is identified as a surrogate bid before attempting the counter offer.

args.because: You cannot send counter offer for bids added by you.

steps.note: Try to counter the surrogate bid and require Procol's specific refusal.
